title: Fleet Agents — Overview (Doris)
description: All three signals from one ClickHouse table set.

list.name: client
list.label: Client type
list.description: The Clients' service.name — one value per kind of Client, not per host.
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT service_name FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT service_name FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge ORDER BY 1

list.name: instance
list.label: Agent
list.description: The Agent each sample is about, which is what separates a Managed Process from the Client that sampled it.
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT CAST(attributes['service.instance.id'] AS STRING) FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT CAST(attributes['service.instance.id'] AS STRING) FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge ORDER BY 1

list.name: platform
list.label: Platform
list.description: The host an Agent runs on, as os.type/host.arch — the two halves ADR-0026 selects a package variant by.
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT CONCAT(CAST(resource_attributes['os.type'] AS STRING), '/', CAST(resource_attributes['host.arch'] AS STRING)) FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT CONCAT(CAST(resource_attributes['os.type'] AS STRING), '/', CAST(resource_attributes['host.arch'] AS STRING)) FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Agents reporting

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(attributes['service.instance.id'] AS STRING))
FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE metric_name = 'process.uptime' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)

panels.description: Distinct Agents that reported a sample in the window — the Client's own Agent and every Managed Process it supervises.

panels.title: Clients reporting

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT service_instance_id)
FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)

panels.description: Distinct Clients, counted by the Resource's service.instance.id. Counting by service.name instead would read 1 for any fleet size.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT SUM(latest)
FROM (SELECT MAX_BY(value, timestamp) AS latest
      FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
      WHERE metric_name = 'process.memory.usage' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
      GROUP BY CAST(attributes['service.instance.id'] AS STRING)) AS per_agent

SELECT MAX(latest)
FROM (SELECT MAX_BY(value, timestamp) AS latest
      FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
      WHERE metric_name = 'process.cpu.utilization' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
      GROUP BY CAST(attributes['service.instance.id'] AS STRING)) AS per_agent

SELECT COUNT(*) / GREATEST(1, MINUTES_DIFF($__timeTo(), $__timeFrom()))
FROM otel.otel_logs
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)

SELECT COUNT(*) / GREATEST(1, MINUTES_DIFF($__timeTo(), $__timeFrom()))
FROM otel.otel_traces
WHERE parent_span_id = '' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)

panels.title: Metrics — what each agent's process is doing

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroup(timestamp, $__interval) AS `time`,
       CAST(attributes['service.instance.id'] AS STRING) AS agent,
       CONCAT_WS(' · ', NULLIF(CAST(attributes['service.instance.name'] AS STRING), ''), NULLIF(CAST(attributes['service.name'] AS STRING), ''), NULLIF(CAST(resource_attributes['os.type'] AS STRING), '')) AS label,
       AVG(value) AS memory
FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE metric_name = 'process.memory.usage' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND service_name REGEXP '${client:regex}'
  AND CAST(attributes['service.instance.id'] AS STRING) REGEXP '${instance:regex}'
  AND CONCAT(CAST(resource_attributes['os.type'] AS STRING), '/', CAST(resource_attributes['host.arch'] AS STRING)) REGEXP '${platform:regex}'
GROUP BY `time`, agent, label
ORDER BY `time`

SELECT $__timeGroup(timestamp, $__interval) AS `time`,
       CAST(attributes['service.instance.id'] AS STRING) AS agent,
       CONCAT_WS(' · ', NULLIF(CAST(attributes['service.instance.name'] AS STRING), ''), NULLIF(CAST(attributes['service.name'] AS STRING), ''), NULLIF(CAST(resource_attributes['os.type'] AS STRING), '')) AS label,
       AVG(value) AS cpu
FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE metric_name = 'process.cpu.utilization' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND service_name REGEXP '${client:regex}'
  AND CAST(attributes['service.instance.id'] AS STRING) REGEXP '${instance:regex}'
  AND CONCAT(CAST(resource_attributes['os.type'] AS STRING), '/', CAST(resource_attributes['host.arch'] AS STRING)) REGEXP '${platform:regex}'
GROUP BY `time`, agent, label
ORDER BY `time`

panels.title: Process uptime

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroup(timestamp, $__interval) AS `time`,
       CAST(attributes['service.instance.id'] AS STRING) AS agent,
       CONCAT_WS(' · ', NULLIF(CAST(attributes['service.instance.name'] AS STRING), ''), NULLIF(CAST(attributes['service.name'] AS STRING), ''), NULLIF(CAST(resource_attributes['os.type'] AS STRING), '')) AS label,
       AVG(value) AS uptime
FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE metric_name = 'process.uptime' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND service_name REGEXP '${client:regex}'
  AND CAST(attributes['service.instance.id'] AS STRING) REGEXP '${instance:regex}'
  AND CONCAT(CAST(resource_attributes['os.type'] AS STRING), '/', CAST(resource_attributes['host.arch'] AS STRING)) REGEXP '${platform:regex}'
GROUP BY `time`, agent, label
ORDER BY `time`

panels.description: A step back to zero is a restart. A gap is a process that was not running when the sample was taken — not an error.

panels.title: Agents

targets.rawSql:
SELECT agent AS `Agent`,
       ANY_VALUE(name) AS `Name`,
       ANY_VALUE(type) AS `Type`,
       ANY_VALUE(client) AS `Client`,
       ANY_VALUE(client_version) AS `Client version`,
       ANY_VALUE(os) AS `OS`,
       ANY_VALUE(arch) AS `Arch`,
       MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'process.memory.usage' THEN latest END) AS `Memory`,
       MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'process.cpu.utilization' THEN latest END) AS `CPU`,
       MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'process.uptime' THEN latest END) AS `Uptime`,
       MAX(last_sample) AS `Last sample`
FROM (SELECT CAST(attributes['service.instance.id'] AS STRING) AS agent,
             metric_name,
             MAX_BY(value, timestamp) AS latest,
             MAX(timestamp) AS last_sample,
             ANY_VALUE(CAST(attributes['service.instance.name'] AS STRING)) AS name,
             ANY_VALUE(CAST(attributes['service.name'] AS STRING)) AS type,
             ANY_VALUE(CAST(resource_attributes['service.instance.name'] AS STRING)) AS client,
             ANY_VALUE(CAST(resource_attributes['service.version'] AS STRING)) AS client_version,
             ANY_VALUE(CAST(resource_attributes['os.type'] AS STRING)) AS os,
             ANY_VALUE(CAST(resource_attributes['host.arch'] AS STRING)) AS arch
      FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
      WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
        AND service_name REGEXP '${client:regex}'
        AND CAST(attributes['service.instance.id'] AS STRING) REGEXP '${instance:regex}'
        AND CONCAT(CAST(resource_attributes['os.type'] AS STRING), '/', CAST(resource_attributes['host.arch'] AS STRING)) REGEXP '${platform:regex}'
      GROUP BY agent, metric_name) AS per_metric
GROUP BY agent
ORDER BY agent

panels.description: All three metrics per Agent in one row, from the newest sample of each. Name and Type are the Agent's own; Client, Client version, OS and Arch describe the Client that sampled it and the host both run on.

panels.title: Logs — what the agents are saying

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroup(timestamp, $__interval) AS `time`, severity_text AS level, COUNT(*) AS lines
FROM otel.otel_logs
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY `time`, level
ORDER BY `time`

SELECT timestamp,
       body,
       severity_text AS level,
       service_name AS service,
       trace_id,
       CAST(log_attributes['code.namespace'] AS STRING) AS target
FROM otel.otel_logs
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 500

SELECT $__timeGroup(timestamp, $__interval) AS `time`, service_name AS service, COUNT(*) AS spans
FROM otel.otel_traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY `time`, service
ORDER BY `time`

SELECT $__timeGroup(timestamp, $__interval) AS `time`,
       service_name AS service,
       PERCENTILE_APPROX(duration, 0.95) / 1000 AS p95_ms
FROM otel.otel_traces
WHERE parent_span_id = '' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY `time`, service
ORDER BY `time`

SELECT trace_id AS `Trace`,
       span_name AS `Operation`,
       timestamp AS `Started`,
       duration / 1000 AS `Duration (ms)`,
       CASE status_code WHEN 'STATUS_CODE_ERROR' THEN 'Error' WHEN 'STATUS_CODE_OK' THEN 'Ok' ELSE 'Unset' END AS `Outcome`,
       CAST(span_attributes['service.instance.id'] AS STRING) AS `Agent`
FROM otel.otel_traces
WHERE parent_span_id = '' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 50
